messages:
sam: heads-up: big customer asked for tiered carryover (different % caps per contract) + an API/export + audit trail in Console.
anya: important: define billing semantics. carryover should be a non-refundable soft credit applied before paid usage and visible on invoice.
billing-bot: Note: carryover_credit_id required on invoice lines for reconciliation.
eng-lead: sketch: add CarryoverPolicy on pool config with tiers, ttl, and emit CARRYOVER_GRANT telemetry (tenant_id, pool_id, amount_tokens, tier, credit_id, expires_at).
oncall: ops needs immutable audit trail in ELK for 90d and an alert if grants spike >3x baseline in 1h.
anya: legal/reg: EU tenants default to carryover_disabled until finance/legal signoff.
sam: UX: per-pool carryover badge + modal + CSV export + GET /v1/pools/:id/carryover_history.
eng-lead: billing consumption order: carryover -> prepaid reserved -> on-demand. That keeps commitments intact.
anya: proposal: default tier=bronze (max_pct=5) for trials; silver/gold via contract. migration path needed for existing ad-hoc credits.
oncall: circuit-breaker: if tenant consumes >50% carryover in a rolling day, emit warning and throttle further carryover application pending review. Also prevent cross-pool stacking with a global_tenant_cap_pct.

carryover_policy example:
- default_tier: bronze
- tiers: bronze(max_pct=5), silver(max_pct=10), gold(max_pct=20)
- ttl_days: 30
- global_tenant_cap_pct: 25

eng-lead: telemetry events: CARRYOVER_GRANT, CARRYOVER_CONSUMED, CARRYOVER_EXPIRED, CARRYOVER_REVOKED with correlation_id for billing.
anya: launch criteria: 1) Console UI + CSV/API; 2) billing export includes carryover_credit_id; 3) audit events to ELK for 90d; 4) default tier + upgrade path; 5) EU signoff or disabled by default.
sam: roadmap: 1-week spike to emit audit events, then 2-week sprint for Console/API; canary with one lighthouse customer in ~6 weeks.
eng-lead: staffing: 2 backend, 1 frontend, 1 billing eng, 1 ops for canary.
product-bot: Created tickets: #PL-4020 (spike), #BILL-2201 (billing export), #FE-789 (console modal), #OPS-1400 (alerts).
anya: action items: eng-lead: spike PR + CARRYOVER_GRANT; billing-bot: CSV schema change; oncall: draft alert thresholds; sam: update roadmap and sales migration messaging.
sam: thanks, will sync with sales after spike results.
